issues.description: The Person.birthday attribute type is inconsistent between template, tests, and the solution. In the template and tests birthday is used as a java.time.LocalDate (e.g. person.setBirthday(LocalDate.now())), but in the solution Person.java the birthday field is declared as String while its getter/setter use LocalDate. This mismatch will cause compilation errors and confusion about the expected type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the birthday attribute type consistent across template, tests, and solution. Change the field declaration in the solution's Person.java from String to java.time.LocalDate (private LocalDate birthday;) and ensure getter/setter use LocalDate. Alternatively, if String is intended, update all tests and usages to use String and adjust serialization accordingly. The recommended fix is to use LocalDate to match the template and tests.
